maximum_permitted_stay: Up to 90 days, as approved; single or multiple entry.
passport_validity_rule: Passport must be valid for more than 6 months at application/entry.
blank_passport_pages_rule: At least 2 blank pages for entry and exit stamps, per official Vietnam Tourism guidance.
return_ticket_rule: Onward or return travel evidence should be available; airline or border officials may request it.
proof_of_funds_rule: No fixed minimum amount published in the official guidance reviewed.
accommodation_rule: Provide Vietnam accommodation or temporary residence details in the application.
travel_insurance_rule: No general tourist e-Visa insurance mandate identified in the official guidance reviewed.
yellow_fever_or_health_rule: No special vaccination requirement identified for ordinary tourist e-Visa in the sources reviewed; check current health rules before travel.
transit_rule: A separate visa may be required if leaving the international transit area; check transit airport and itinerary.
application_channel: Apply online while outside Vietnam through the official Immigration Department portal at https://evisa.gov.vn; upload passport data page and portrait photo; complete form and pay online; print approved e-Visa.
application_fee: USD 25 single-entry; USD 50 multiple-entry (government e-Visa fee; non-refundable).
processing_time: Usually 3–5 working days per Vietnam National Authority of Tourism 2026 guidance; allow additional time.
required_documents: Valid ordinary passport|Digital image of passport data page|Recent portrait photograph|Completed online application details|Email address for application correspondence|Online payment method
official_immigration_source_name: Vietnam Immigration Department – National Electronic Visa Portal
cross_check_source_name: Vietnam National Authority of Tourism – Visa Requirements (2026)
review_notes: Bangladeshi ordinary passport holders require an entry visa for mainland Vietnam; the electronic visa is available to citizens of all countries and territories. Current 2026 Vietnam National Authority of Tourism guidance states e-Visas are available to all nationalities, up to 90 days, single or multiple entry, USD 25 single-entry and USD 50 multiple-entry, with an indicative 3–5 working-day processing period. The Immigration Department portal confirms the e-Visa is for foreigners outside Vietnam, valid up to 90 days, single or multiple entry, and requires a valid passport. The Vietnam Tourism authority states passport validity of at least six months and two blank pages. The Phu Quoc 30-day exemption is a narrow island-only exception and does not authorize onward travel to mainland Vietnam without a visa. Fee is non-refundable; application and entry remain subject to approval. Checked 2026-11-14.
notes: Full BGD tourism audit completed for Vietnam; other visa categories are not covered.
